rationale: Focus timing shares business semantics across devices, while Circle uses a ring-first composition and Pill/Rect use a value-first column. Settings and statistics reuse list semantics but keep shape-aware geometry.

shapeStrategy.circle: Ring-first focus surface with chord-safe controls; compact centered list geometry for settings and statistics.
shapeStrategy.pill: Tall value-first column with full-width list rows and bottom controls.
shapeStrategy.rect: Value-first column with width-aware rows and bottom controls.
